note: Recent clinical case reports demonstrate prenatal presentations of MSL2-related syndrome featuring ventriculomegaly, thickened nuchal translucency, and lymphangioma.

evidence.text: Describes a prenatal case of MSL2-related disorder presenting with bilateral moderate ventriculomegaly in a fetus with a de novo MSL2 splice variant.

source.title: Prenatal Diagnosis of MSL2‐Related Ventriculomegaly in Association With an Inherited 15q13 Microduplication
source.quote: We report the first prenatal case of an MSL2-related pathology caused by a de novo MSL2 splice variant (c.142+1G>T). ... The fetus, who presented with bilateral moderate ventriculomegaly, also carried a paternally inherited 15q13 microduplication.

evidence.text: Reports thickened nuchal translucency, lymphangioma, and ventriculomegaly as prenatal phenotypes expanding the clinical spectrum of MSL2-related developmental disorders.

source.title: Thickened Nuchal Translucency, Lymphangioma, and Ventriculomegaly: Prenatal Phenotypes for MSL2‐Related Disorders
source.quote: In conclusion, this case expands the prenatal phenotypic spectrum of MSL2‐related … ventriculomegaly.
